name: Flawless Victories
desc:
Win %d matches without your opponent taking a single Prize card.
• Only counts in matches where both players start with at least 4 Prize cards

name: Deck Out Wins
desc: Win %d matches because your opponent ran out of cards to draw.

name: Multi Knockout
desc:
Score %d Multi Knockout points.
• +1 for every extra Pokemon you Knock Out in a single turn (a Double Knockout is +1, a Triple Knockout +2)
• Only counts in matches you win

name: Sniper
desc:
Knock Out %d Benched Pokemon.
• Only counts in matches you win

name: Healer
desc:
Heal %d damage in total.
• Only counts in matches you win

name: Evolution Master
desc:
Evolve your Pokemon %d times.
• Only counts in matches you win

name: Poison Master
desc:
Knock Out %d Pokemon with Poison.
• Only counts in matches you win

name: Burn Master
desc:
Knock Out %d Pokemon with a Burn.
• Only counts in matches you win

name: Inflictor
desc:
Give your opponent's Pokemon %d Special Conditions.
• Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed and Poisoned all count
• Only counts in matches you win

name: Board Wipe
desc: Knock Out 6 of your opponent's Pokemon in a single turn and win the match.

name: Crazy Damage
desc: Do 500 or more damage with a single attack and win the match.

name: Ultra Healer
desc: Heal 1,000 or more damage in a single match and win it.

name: Super Comeback
desc: Win a match after falling 5 Prize cards behind your opponent.

name: Only One
desc:
Win a match with only one Pokemon ever played.
• Never put a Pokemon on your Bench (evolving it is fine)

name: Last Resort
desc: Win a match with your Active Pokemon on 10 HP or less and nothing on your Bench.

name: Empty Deck
desc: Win a match with no cards left in your deck.

name: Speedrun
desc: Win a match within 6 turns (3 each).

name: Marathon
desc:
Win a match that lasts more than 49 turns.
• Both players' turns count

name: Why are you hitting yourself?
desc: Win a match in which one of your opponent's Pokemon Knocks itself Out with Confusion.

name: There's no way...
desc:
Flip 25 heads in a single match.
• Only counts in matches you win

name: This game is rigged...
desc:
Flip 25 tails in a single match.
• Only counts in matches you win

name: Grass Master
desc:
Win %d matches with a deck of only Grass type Pokemon
• Deck MUST contain at least 6 different Pokemon (with different names)
• Deck CANNOT contain any other Pokemon types (including Colorless Pokemon)
• Deck CAN contain any Energy cards
• Pokemon attack requirements do not matter
